categories.main_business_segments: AECOM operates through three primary business segments: Americas, International, and AECOM Capital (ACAP). The Americas segment provides planning, consulting, architectural and engineering design, construction management, and program management services in the United States, Canada, and Latin America. The International segment delivers similar services across Europe, the Middle East, India, Africa, and the Asia-Australia-Pacific regions. AECOM Capital primarily invests in and develops real estate projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: AECOM's core capabilities center on fee-based, knowledge-driven professional services, including advisory, planning, consulting, architectural and engineering design, and program/construction management. The company leverages advanced digital tools, proprietary data libraries, and innovative solutions such as DE-FLUORO™ for PFAS water treatment. AECOM emphasizes digital transformation, sustainability, and technical excellence in project delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: AECOM serves a diverse client base, primarily national, state, regional, and local governments, as well as public and private institutions and major corporations. Key end markets include transportation, water, government, facilities, environmental, and energy sectors. No single client accounts for more than 10% of revenue, and approximately 43% of revenue in 2023 was derived from government entities.
categories.geographic_coverage: AECOM operates globally, with significant presence in the Americas (United States, Canada, Latin America), Europe, the Middle East, India, Africa, and the Asia-Australia-Pacific regions. In 2023, about 29% of revenue was generated outside the United States, with notable growth in the United Kingdom, Middle East, and Australia.
categories.supply_chain_position: AECOM primarily operates as a downstream service provider, delivering professional services directly to end clients. The company does not manufacture physical products but manages projects, provides consulting, and oversees construction and development, often acting as a prime contractor or program manager and sometimes as an investor through AECOM Capital.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: AECOM's strategic focus is on expanding its leadership in professional infrastructure consulting, accelerating digital transformation, and advancing ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) initiatives. The company invests in proprietary digital solutions, sustainability, decarbonization, and resilience, with a commitment to net zero emissions by 2040 and ongoing innovation in project delivery and client engagement.
categories.revenue_model: AECOM primarily generates revenue through fee-based, knowledge-driven services, billing clients for employee time and project management. Revenue streams include cost-reimbursable, guaranteed maximum price, and fixed-price contracts. AECOM Capital earns income from real estate development sales and management fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AECOM competes in a highly fragmented global market against regional, national, and international firms, ranging from small private companies to large multinationals. It is ranked as the second largest general architectural and engineering design firm globally and holds leading positions in transportation, facilities, and environmental markets. The company differentiates itself through scale, technical expertise, and digital innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2023, AECOM reported $14.4 billion in revenue, up 9.4% from the prior year. The company had a backlog of $41.2 billion as of September 30, 2023, and employed approximately 52,000 people. While net income attributable to AECOM was $55 million in 2023 (down from $311 million in 2022, due to impairment charges), the company maintains strong liquidity and continues to invest in growth and margin improvement.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AECOM emphasizes its ability to deliver innovative, sustainable, and resilient infrastructure solutions through technical excellence, digital capabilities, and a global talent base. The company positions itself as a trusted partner for complex challenges, leveraging its scale, proprietary technologies, and ESG leadership to create value for clients and communities worldwide.
